blurb: Choose shorter outings or agency-listed day trips between Fort Ripley, Fletcher Creek, Belle Prairie and LeBourget Park. Allow for riffles, wind and changing water levels. The Little Falls finish is upstream of the dam; these trips do not cross it.

sections.difficulty: Moving water with riffles and rock bars
sections.notes: The DNR-recommended day trip from Fort Ripley Landing to Fletcher Creek. Riffles and rock bars occur around Pipe Island and toward the Highway 115 bridge; late-season water can be shallow. Check the landing and arrange a vehicle shuttle.
sections.routeReview: Approximate DNR river-course overview. Exact landing connections, current obstructions and alternate channels are not mapped; published planning mileage stays separate. The line generalizes the west-side island channel and rock bars near Camp Ripley; it does not select a passage through riffles.

notices.title: Riffles and restricted shoreline
notices.text: Rock-bar riffles occur near Pipe Island and downstream toward the Highway 115 bridge. The DNR states that entry to the Camp Ripley Training Center from the river is prohibited. Use designated public accesses; the map does not establish landing rights along the military shoreline.

putInAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
putInAccess.note: The agency GPS point is beside the riverfront approach under vegetation, rather than a clearly resolved ramp end. Retain a documented access area, not an invented water-edge coordinate.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed Fort Ripley Landing off Highway 371 near the Nokasippi River, south of Brainerd. The DNR lists a concrete trailer ramp. Inspect the signed public approach and river conditions while arranging your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
takeOutAccess.note: DNR lists a concrete trailer ramp. The source point is at a vegetated bank beside the access turnout; the water-edge ramp end is not clear enough for a precise pin.
takeOutAccess.directions: From County Road 213/Grouse Road south of Camp Ripley, use 210th Street east to the public access entry road. Follow signs to Fletcher Creek landing and check the ramp during your shuttle. This is the DNR-recommended take-out below the Highway 115 bridge.

notices.title: Take out before Little Falls Dam
notices.text: LeBourget Park is at river mile 965.6, upstream of Little Falls Dam at 965.2. This trip ends at the park ramp. It does not include a dam passage or portage; locate the take-out before starting.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — LeBourget public water access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: The unchanged DNR GPS point matches the visible concrete ramp apron at the water edge beside the dock. City May 2026 material confirms this public water access and address. Desktop agency-and-imagery check, not a field survey; the dock replacement proposal does not establish present dock availability.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the public ramp at LeBourget Park, 300 Paul Larson Memorial Drive NW, on the west bank of the Mississippi. This landing is upstream of the Little Falls Dam. Identify it during your shuttle and finish here; do not continue downstream toward the dam.
takeOutAccess.bankNote: DNR records R, facing downstream; imagery and the Headwaters Board trip map place the landing on the west bank above Little Falls Dam.
